<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the base peak at m/z 127.0997 is most consistent with a protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern shows an M+1 peak at ~8 % intensity, which corresponds to ~7–8 carbons (since each carbon contributes ~1.1 % 13C). The formula C₈H₁₄O has a calculated exact mass of 126.1045 Da (≈12 mDa higher, ~95 ppm) and contains 8 carbons, matching the observed isotopic pattern. No other heteroatoms are indicated. Therefore the most plausible molecular formula is C8H14O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
